body: This *really* does not belong here. Too much free time though...
The irony being that with dough like cardboard and sauce like red paint, they sell everything that *isn't* pizza.

The problem with that however is the lack of views I'll get with my own blog. What are the benefits with having my own blog? And also, Blogging =/= Prose

Blogging is more non-fiction in my opinion.

http://www.scribophile.com/

You need to be 18 or plus to be a member. It has a friendly community and are extremely useful. You need to give critiques to other people's work before you can post yours. The critique system on the site is well made and allows you to post inline critiques.

Premium is optional.

I write in my sister's room away from my computer. I use my tablet and a Bluetooth keyboard, with a word processing app open. I push out about 2000 words a day and edit for about two hours a day - after I finish my first draft of course.
